hook: Table khud se hi join? Haan, [[boss dhundhne]] ke liye

slides.title: SELF JOIN = [[khud se]]
points: Ek hi table ko **do baar** use karo
slides.note: Jaise mirror ke saamne baat karna: **wahi table, do roop** 🪞

slides.title: manager_id ka [[khel]]
slides.note: manager_id **isi table** ki id ko point karta. Aarav = top boss 👑

slides.title: Boss [[dhoondo]]
slides.code:
SELECT e.name AS employee,
       m.name AS manager
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN employees m
  ON e.manager_id = m.id;

slides.title: INNER vs [[LEFT]] yahan
slides.note: Top boss ka koi manager nahi, isliye **LEFT JOIN** safe choice

slides.title: Aur [[kahan]] kaam aata?
slides.note: "Manager se zyada salary wale employees" = classic **SELF JOIN** sawaal 🔥

slides.wrong:
SELECT name, name
FROM employees
JOIN employees
  ON manager_id = id;
slides.right:
SELECT e.name, m.name
FROM employees e
JOIN employees m
  ON e.manager_id = m.id;
slides.why: Alias nahi to SQL confuse: **kaunsi copy** ka name? → error
